model: EmbeddingGemma 2 cut to its first 4 layers, distilled 10 epochs onto EG2 q4 query vectors (experiments#103, eg2-layer-student)
space: EG2 q4 (onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX model_q4.onnx) query vectors, 768-d; documents stay EG2
tokenize: tokenizer.json (32K cut, BPE-closed, byte fallback) on prompt + text, including its special-token post-processing (BOS); truncate ids to max_tokens

files.model_q4w.onnx: q4 layers + 4-bit table, standard-op unpack; onnxruntime-web wasm + WebGPU
files.model_t3w.onnx: q4 layers + 3-bit table (smaller, same hit@10); wasm + WebGPU

caveat: distilled only on the query prompt above over Bluesky-style text; other prompts or domains (e.g. image alt text) are untested
